name: nanoKONTROL2 — VALIDATION (4 controls)
description: Minimal map to confirm MIDI is working. Touch any of these 4 controls and watch huff respond immediately. Once confirmed, load nanokontrol2-full.json.

mappings._section: FADER 1 → FEEDBACK (push it up and down, the image should smear/clear)

mappings.note: Fader 1 — default CC 0 on nanoKONTROL2 Scene 1

mappings._section: KNOB 1 → CORRUPT % (turn it, glitch tiles should appear/disappear)

mappings.note: Knob 1 — default CC 16 on nanoKONTROL2 Scene 1

mappings._section: SOLO BUTTON 1 → GLITCH ON/OFF (press it, all glitch should toggle)

mappings.note: Solo 1 — default CC 32 on nanoKONTROL2 Scene 1. Value >63 = ON, <=63 = OFF

mappings._section: MUTE BUTTON 1 → BASE VIDEO ON/OFF (press it, source video toggles)

mappings.note: Mute 1 — default CC 48 on nanoKONTROL2 Scene 1
